import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
base = Path('/tmp/dewy-source-core/profile-2026-10-17')
base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copytree(root/'core/compiler', base/'compiler', dirs_exist_ok=True)
(base/'bin').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
if not (base/'lib').exists():
    (base/'lib').symlink_to(root/'core/lib', target_is_directory=True)

p = base/'compiler/opt.jo'
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('optimize = ():\n    o_sra()', 'profile_opt: f64[] = fill(0.0, 5)\n\noptimize = ():\n    pt = time()\n    o_sra()\n    profile_opt[0] += time() - pt\n    pt = time()', 1)
s = s.replace('    # forward: fold, propagate copies, eliminate common subexpressions, drop dead branches', '    profile_opt[1] += time() - pt\n    pt = time()\n    # forward: fold, propagate copies, eliminate common subexpressions, drop dead branches', 1)
s = s.replace('    # backward: drop pure instructions whose results are unused', '    profile_opt[2] += time() - pt\n    pt = time()\n    # backward: drop pure instructions whose results are unused', 1)
s = s.replace('    ir.code = o_cleanup(code)', '    profile_opt[3] += time() - pt\n    pt = time()\n    ir.code = o_cleanup(code)\n    profile_opt[4] += time() - pt', 1)
p.write_text(s)
p = base/'compiler/lower.jo'
s = p.read_text().replace('lower_function = (lf: int):', '''profile_lower = 0.0
lower_function = (lf: int):
    pt = time()
    lower_function_impl(lf)
    profile_lower += time() - pt

lower_function_impl = (lf: int):''', 1)
p.write_text(s)
p = base/'compiler/main.jo'
s = p.read_text().replace('emit_now = (finish: bool):', '''profile_emit = 0.0
emit_now = (finish: bool):
    pt = time()
    emit_now_impl(finish)
    profile_emit += time() - pt

emit_now_impl = (finish: bool):''', 1)
s = s.replace('    if timing:\n', '    eprint("PROFILE {profile_lower} {profile_emit} {profile_opt[0]} {profile_opt[1]} {profile_opt[2]} {profile_opt[3]} {profile_opt[4]}\\n")\n    if timing:\n', 1)
p.write_text(s)
state = json.loads((root/'__dewycache__/compact-core/current.json').read_text())
compiler = root/'__dewycache__/compact-core'/state['binary']
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('DEWY_', 'SLOPPY_'))}
env.update(SLOPPY_LIB=str(base/'lib'), SLOPPY_EMIT_WORKERS='1')
built = subprocess.run([compiler, 'build', base/'compiler/main.jo', '-o', base/'bin/dewy-core'], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
if built.returncode:
    raise RuntimeError(built.stdout + built.stderr)
report = {'fields': ['lower', 'emit_including_finish', 'sra', 'metadata', 'cse', 'dead_code', 'cleanup'],
          'note': 'Instrumented wall-clock totals; optimizer phases may overlap emit time.',
          'revision': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
          'script': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'load_start': os.getloadavg(), 'runs': {}}
for name, source, flags in [('tour', 'examples/sloppy_core/tour.dewy', ['--release']),
                            ('physics', 'examples/sloppy_core/physics.dewy', ['--release']),
                            ('compiler', 'core/compiler/main.jo', [])]:
    rows = []
    for _ in range(3):
        ran = subprocess.run([base/'bin/dewy-core', 'build', source, *flags, '--time', '-o', base/(name+'-output')], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
        if ran.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(ran.stdout + ran.stderr)
        print(name, ran.stderr, flush=True)
        row = next(line for line in ran.stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith('PROFILE '))
        rows.append({'seconds': dict(zip(report['fields'], map(float, row.split()[1:]))), 'log': ran.stderr})
    report['runs'][name] = rows
report['load_end'] = os.getloadavg()
(root/'dewy/audits/2026-10-17/source-core/compiler-profile.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
